title: Replacement of Lantern house outside gallery segments at Vizhinjam Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting quotation for fabricating and fitting two new mild-steel chequered plate segments on the lantern house outside gallery of Vizhinjam Lighthouse, drilling and repainting all six segments.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Vizhinjam Lighthouse, Vizhinjam (PO), Thiruvananthapuram Dist., Kerala 695521
sites.work: Replacement of lantern house outside gallery chequered plate segments

scope.item: Fabrication and installation of 02 nos chequered sheets incl. profile cutting, drilling 04 nos mounting holes each, fabrication of 20x20mm side strip (MS chequered plate 10mm IS 3502; SS fasteners M12x60)
Labour for drilling 10mm dia holes (3mm x 45 deg chamfer), 10 holes in each of 06 chequered plates
Supply of painting materials and painting 06 chequered plates and complete assembly with 2 coats anti-rust epoxy primer and 2 coats enamel (black/white)
Transportation, loading/unloading and lifting of materials/equipment to top of lighthouse tower

money.notes: EMD printed as N.A. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory completion; payment on actual measurement. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately.

period.completion: 30 days from the date of work order
period.bid_validity: 60 days from the date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or authorized suppliers, contractors, parties or Government undertakings
specs: Mild steel chequered plate 10 mm thick (IS 3502) with MS side strip 20x20 mm
Stainless steel fasteners M10/M12 x 60 mm hex bolts (8), nuts (8), washers (16); SS 316 (A4-70/80) or SS 304 (A2-70/80); Unbrako, TVS or reputed make
Outside gallery of 3.0 m lantern house has 06 chequered sheets, 02 to be replaced; drawing dimensions 2099 mm and 1639 mm

documents.file: NIQReplacement of Lantern house outside gallery (1).pdf

notes: Quotation download 20.03.2024 09:00 to 27.03.2024 14:00; submission 20.03.2024 10:00 to 27.03.2024 15:00; opening 28.03.2024 15:00. Schedule has no quantity column values; quantities taken from item descriptions. Note 2 refers to 'sealed quotation with EMD' although EMD is N.A. Mounting holes stated as 04 in schedule; scope clause iii-iv says 10 holes per plate (60 total). Page 6 is the chequered plate drawing.
